title: Backend Developer — Expert in Archiving and Data Management
description: A backend developer with strong expertise in electronic archiving and data management is required to participate in the construction of a comprehensive legal platform powered by artificial intelligence targeting the Saudi market. The role will involve developing backend systems and programming interfaces, designing and managing databases, and building a document storage and classification system that efficiently retrieves its content. The role includes integrating AI services and processing documents, ensuring data protection, managing access permissions, and maintaining system stability and scalability. Work System: Remote from Egypt, full-time, with compliance to working hours compatible with Saudi Arabian time. Skills Strong practical experience in backend system development and building programming interfaces (APIs), with previous projects actively functioning. Proficiency in designing and managing databases, particularly PostgreSQL or equivalent, and optimizing queries and data handling performance. Advanced experience in developing electronic archiving systems and managing documents, including classification, indexing, searching, and retrieval, not limited to file uploads and storage. Experience in handling PDF files and images, extracting text and data using OCR techniques, with the ability to process Arabic content. Operational knowledge of integrating AI models and services within systems and applications. Experience in data protection and managing user permissions and backup copies, and building scalable systems capable of handling large volumes of documents.

title: Computer Analyst, Designer, and Programmer
description: The general description of the position: Analysis of technical requirements and design of programs or electronic systems, their programming, testing, and maintenance, to ensure that client needs are met efficiently and securely. Responsibilities: • Creating electronic sites and platforms and designing programs and applications related to them, and employing artificial intelligence applications creatively. • Analyzing user requirements and converting them into electronic programs and applications. • Writing software scripts and testing them and correcting errors. • Developing existing systems and programs and improving their performance. • Reviewing system or application requirements with the system analyst or requestor, and defining the scope of work, inputs, and required outputs. • Preparing a program solution map, identifying its components and the data that needs to be stored and how the user interacts with it. • Protecting data and systems and ensuring compliance with security and quality standards. • Keeping up with the latest programming technologies and languages. • Linking the program to data rules or other system interfaces when needed. • Testing functions and expected scenarios, recording and correcting errors before the program launch. • Documenting the program design and how it operates and the changes that may occur. • Monitoring technical communications related to the programs, identifying causes of malfunction and addressing them or escalating them to the specialized team. • Implementing data security protocols, such as verifying access permissions and protecting data, according to policy guidelines. • Coordinating with users, analysts, designers, and data rules custodians to meet client needs. Skills Qualifications and requirements: • Bachelor's degree or diploma in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field. • Practical experience and knowledge of more than one programming language. • Familiarity with database fundamentals and queries, understanding design tables and relationships. • Experience using source code management tools and version control management. • Understanding the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, programming, testing, deployment, and maintenance. • Ability to read technical requirements and translate them into programmable steps. • Skill in tracking errors, analyzing their causes, and testing solutions. • Commitment to documenting work and protecting data confidentiality. • Experience in practical projects is an added advantage.
